Q1 and Q2 RULED at post-01M19G59H5QHMYTN0M3Z0K5RPZ on collab's disposition, after verifying all five of their factual claims (four confirmed; their module count 15 crossProject + 2 JVM-only = 17 was more precise than my own grep of 24 lazy vals).

Q1: one site, three explicit routes, PRIMARY READER the methods-minded cognitive scientist. Collaborator route public but visually separate and never the default path; AGENTS.md and the board stay internal.
Q2: orientation + one honest success first, concepts second, generated reference last.

CONSTRAINT ELEVATED TO THIS BEAD: pointing Astro at docs/ would publish repository archaeology by default. docs/ is ADRs with dissent, audits, admission ledgers, gate records -- primary sources, not pages. The site is AUTHORED and CITES that tree; it does not render it. Any proposal beginning 'point the content collection at docs/' is rejected on sight.

SECOND CONSTRAINT: the docs site must not be more confident than the README, which already says pre-release, APIs unstable, raw-text-to-complete-model unfinished, fixtures hand-modeled.

Q3-Q6 remain open. Q6 changes meaning now that bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX records that there is no CI to produce a receipt.

CANDIDACY: collab volunteered and is strongest on evidence. Owner's call. Cost flagged: collab is our most effective independent reviewer and appointing them SPENDS that rather than duplicating it; if they write the docs we must name a replacement corrector at the same time.
